long_biography.plain_text:
Joseph B. 'Joe' Simone began in automotive recycling, establishing Hunts Point Auto Parts with his father. He reinvested earnings from the business in property and later launched Simone Development Companies with his father, whose salvage and trucking operation had already accumulated industrial sites in the Bronx.

As president, Simone directs a family-owned real-estate platform combining investment, development, construction, leasing and property management. Its work spans healthcare facilities, offices, industrial sites, retail centres, mixed-use schemes and housing. He has remained directly involved in projects ranging from medical campuses to workforce housing, extending the business beyond its original industrial-property base.
